notes.title: THE DEMON STONE is officially released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am ZHANG CHENING, a solo game creator. The independent game "The Demon Stone" that I spent about 4 months creating can finally be presented to everyone today. This is my second independent game and also my first attempt at making RPG style games. 
Unlike typical RPG games, this game adopts turn based combat, allowing players to freely choose the combination of professions and skills. At present, there are 5 professions with different positioning in the game, each with regular attacks and two active skills. More active and passive skills will be added in the future, and feedback from players during the game will be accepted to make adjustments to existing skills. 

The following are the areas that this game will continue to focus on developing in the future: 
-Improvement of existing original artwork 
-More sound effects and music 
-Balance between professions and enemies 
-New copy content 
-More weapons and equipment 
-More NPC characters and scenes 
-More innovative skills and related gameplay 

If you have any further questions or suggestions, you can send them to your email: 
979803203@qq.com 

Thank you all for your support!
